summary: Initialized Kohakuyasha as the repository-backed single source of truth.
Implemented the portable Windows foundation: bootstrap/runtime acquisition, core, SQLite, tray, watchdog, localhost web UI, live observation, autostart, diagnostics, safe mode and automated tests.

Hardened local HTTP/WebSocket security, bootstrap reproducibility, restart/watchdog behavior, runtime cleanup, configuration/database recovery, autostart encoding, tray responsiveness and web UI load behavior.
